related_questions.question: What credit score is needed for Honda financing?

text_blocks.snippet: While Honda doesn't have a set minimum credit score for financing, a score of 661 or higher is generally considered prime, which can help you get better loan terms, according to Experian. However, even with lower scores, you may still be able to secure financing, though potentially with higher interest rates.

list.title: Prime (661-780):
list.snippet: A score in this range generally results in easier loan approvals and potentially better interest rates.

list.title: Non-prime (601-660):
list.snippet: This range may still qualify for financing, but with higher interest rates, according to First Texas Honda.

list.title: Subprime (501-600):
list.snippet: Securing financing at this level can be more challenging, and interest rates may be higher.

list.title: Deep subprime (300-500):
list.snippet: This is the most challenging range, and interest rates are likely to be very high.

text_blocks.snippet: Ultimately, your credit score is just one factor in Honda's financing decisions. Lenders also consider your income, credit history, and the overall loan amount, says Medium.
